independence: Fresh non-author linguistic reviewer. No current draft or contract authorship; no edits to learner/key/contract/shared indexes/registers. scope: All 38 learner-facing literal systems and all 324 labelled cells, nine diagnostic principal-part rows, bounded lexical families and relevant government. No derived-display shortcut cells; rule-derived morphological forms are explicitly distinguished from individually attested source tokens.
method: Read actual learner tables and explanatory prose.
Personally view selected primary lexical/rule images; source-audit assertions only locate evidence.
Specify the expected surfaces independently in reviewer scratch before comparing them with the actual parsed table coordinates.
Check every cell for surface, analysis and production/reference scope; compare canonical records as an additional structural check.
Check requested-form key answers against the independently checked forms, and bounded word-family semantics/government against primary examples.
